g.text: Each time the world's installed solar capacity doubled, module prices fell by about a quarter. Over 22

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: doublings since 1975, a watt of panel went from $132 to 12 cents, in 2025 dollars.
